title: Comparison origin of the coefficient-sized localization kernel
statement: For affine X and complementary closed i:Z→X and quasi-compact open j:U→X, let F be a coefficient-sized pro-etale sheaf of A-modules. If its open restriction j^*F is in the etale comparison essential image, the kernel of the canonical closed unit is in the etale comparison essential image over X. This is only the kernel part of localization; it asserts no epimorphy.

proof.text: Choose an etale antecedent G and an isomorphism nu_U^*G ≅ j^*F from the hypothesis. Its etale open extension is an explicit candidate antecedent over X.

Apply coefficientOpenExtensionComparisonIso to G. This gives nu_X^*(j_!^et G) ≅ j_!^proet(nu_U^*G). Apply the constructed pro-etale extension functor to the given isomorphism, giving j_!^proet(nu_U^*G) ≅ j_!^proet(j^*F).

Compose with coefficientOpenClosedKernelIso, identifying j_!^proet(j^*F) with the kernel of the canonical closed unit. These three actual Lean isomorphisms exhibit the desired essential-image witness.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AF and 09AH; the extension-comparison construction is proved, the kernel identification is isolated without any etale-origin assertion.

theorem coefficientFixed_localization_kernel_comparison
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    {X Z U : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hU : Set.range j = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
      (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A))
    (hj : (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} U) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} U)
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} U)).essImage
      ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, v} j A).obj F))
    [HasKernel (C := Sheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
      (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)) ((coefficientFixedCanonicalAdj.{u, v} A i).unit.app F)] :
    (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)).essImage
        (kernel (C := Sheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
          (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A))
          ((coefficientFixedCanonicalAdj.{u, v} A i).unit.app F))
